drill.name: Supported double-leg calf raise
drill.notes: Begin only once pain has settled, you no longer need crutches and you can stand on your toes without pain. Hold a stable chair, share your weight equally over both feet and gently rise onto your toes, then lower slowly. Work at your own pace and stop if painful. Keep both feet on level ground; do not add weight, single-leg work, a step or fatigue progressions.
drill.evidence_notes: Sources: https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/sprains-and-strains/, https://www.hey.nhs.uk/patient-leaflet/soft-tissue-injury-calf-strain/. Reviewed fixed baseline; no numerical dose or automatic advanced-stage clearance.
